functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox.__init__
functions.description: Initializes the TestToolbox for a particular test plan.

parameters.name: test_plan_path
parameters.description: A valid path to a script's test plan .json file.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox.prepare_for_self_test
functions.description: Prepares the TestToolbox for self-testing by setting up the test environment.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox.execute_test_plan
functions.description:
Executes all test cases defined in the test plan.
Requires the following class variables have valid values:
    self.test_folder_path
    self.test_plan

parameters.name: test_case_name
parameters.description: The name of the test case to execute. If None, all test cases will be executed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing details about the results of the test plan execution

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._log_final_report
functions.description:
Formats the final_report dictionary for human readability and logs it
line by line.

parameters.name: final_report
parameters.description: The report dictionary to format and log.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._execute_test_case
functions.description:
Given a test case name, runs all tests within that test case and returns the results.
Assumes self.tc_name, self.tc_type, self.tc_subtype, and self.test_case_dict[self.tc_name] are set.

returns.description: A dictionary conforming to _TC_RESULT_DICT with results of the test case execution.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._execute_single_test_definition
functions.description: Executes all steps for a single test definition (e.g., one item from the "tests" list in a test case JSON).

parameters.name: test_def
parameters.description: The dictionary for a single test definition.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._prepare_test_environment
functions.description: Loads files and prepares functions needed for the test.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._run_unit_test_steps
functions.description: Executes steps for a unit test and updates result_dict.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._run_integration_test_steps
functions.description: Executes steps for an integration test and updates result_dict.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._run_full_test_steps
functions.description: Executes steps for a full test. Similar to integration but may have more complex validation.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._resolve_parameters
functions.description: Resolves parameter values based on their definitions (hardcoded, from return_store, or from loaded files).

parameters.name: params_config
parameters.description: The "params" dictionary from a test step.

returns.description: A dictionary of resolved parameter names and their actual values.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._resolve_single_param_value
functions.description:
Resolves a single parameter's value.
Sources can be:
- "hardcoded_value" (literal string, taken as is unless it's a special type)
- Special hardcoded: "true", "false", "null"/"none", integers, floats
- "return_X" (from self.return_value_store)
- "file_key.path.to.value" (from self.loaded_test_files, e.g., "json_0.some_dict.value")
- "path/to/some_file_listed_in_files_key" (resolves to the absolute path of the file)

parameters.name: param_value_source
parameters.description: The string defining how to get the parameter's value.

returns.description: The resolved value and an error message if resolution failed, else None.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._validate_file_contents
functions.description:
Validates file contents based on a list of check strings.
Each check string is "file_key_or_path:OPERATOR:operand"
e.g., "json_1:IS:json_2" -> content of file for json_1 is identical to content of file for json_2
      "output.txt:HAS:Some string"
      "output.txt:EXCLUDES:Error string"

returns.description: Overall validation status and list of failure reasons.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._load_test_files_content
functions.description:
Loads content of specified files (JSON, CSV) into self.loaded_test_files.
Also populates self.test_files_path_list with their absolute paths.

parameters.name: files_map
parameters.description:
A dictionary like {"json_0": "file.json", "csv_0": "data.csv"}
                                     from the test definition's "files" key.

returns.description: True if all essential files were loaded successfully, False otherwise.

functions.name: test_toolbox.TestToolbox._prepare_functions_for_test
functions.description:
Prepares callable functions/methods based on identifiers (e.g., "script_file.func" or "toolbox.Class.method").
Stores them in self.prepared_functions.

returns.description: True if all functions were prepared successfully.
